blocks.text: Arid. Parched. Scorched. The Philippines, an archipelago inherently vulnerable to climate variability, faces an escalating threat from the El Niño-Southern Oscillation phenomenon. As global temperatures continue to rise due to climate change, meteorologists warn of an alarming shift toward extended and more intense El Niño cycles.
